executive_summary: The infrastructure shows moderate risk with underutilized and potentially unresponsive servers, lack of redundancy, and unknown utilization levels. Immediate attention is required to address these issues.

predicted_failures.description: The server is underutilized but has critical workloads. A hardware failure could lead to service disruption.
The server has unknown utilization and no active workloads, indicating it may be non-functional.

root_causes.description: The infrastructure lacks redundancy, with critical services running on a single server.

preventive_measures.action: Implement load balancing and failover mechanisms for critical services.
preventive_measures.rationale: This will ensure that if one server fails, another can take over without service disruption.
